overall.summary: The development application is refused due to two key contraventions. Firstly, no site-specific development control plan has been prepared for the site, which is a requirement for development within the Frenchs Forest Precinct. Secondly, the site area is less than the minimum required for a residential flat building on Site G. A design review panel is also required due to the building's height.
